required_fixes: Do not use the corrected-model power-law extrapolation (n50 agreement 0.575 PI90 [0.511,0.774]) to justify product or Docker decisions. It is gated behind C1 FAIL and built on sign-crossing |margin| power law from n=4 points with R²=0.197 vs std R²=0.867. Per frozen rule NOT C1 -> MEASUREMENT_INVALID regardless of C2/C3, the extrapolation must be treated as exploratory and unvalidated.

Replace the tested noise decomposition Phi(mean(M)/std(M)) with a decomposition that separates sign from magnitude. Current test conflates mean (sign) and std (magnitude): at n20 mean 3.97e-04 / std 6.23e-04 = SNR 0.637 -> Phi 0.7379 vs observed 0.5595 residual 17.8pp. Diagnostic proportion(margin_i>0)=0.5654 residual 0.59pp shows agreement is driven by sign fraction, not mean/std ratio. Next prereg should test (a) Phi(median(|M|)/std) or (b) non-linear mapping of empirical margin distribution or (c) between-type vs within-type variance decomposition, preregister C1' = |predicted-observed| <=10pp at n15 and n20.

Treat null-control comparison as disclosed tautology at n15: null predicts 0.499208 vs observed 0.4998 error 0.0006 will always beat any model predicting ~0.56 at n15 where observed is ~0.50. Next prereg must define NC1 as corrected-model error < null error at n20 only, or as aggregate RMSE across n15+n20, and report both raw errors. Current NC1 FAIL (0.065 vs 0.0006 at n15, 0.178 vs 0.060 at n20) correctly evaluated but does not by itself falsify mechanism.

Retain disclosure of template invariance and single-site truncation scope as bounds, not fixes. Template invariance verified true for listing/detail/cart on truncated-first-20, forcing rho=1.0 as scalar-multiple tautology (elements_with_bbox listing 1550/1560/1564 detail 1215/1149/1143) and nullifying rho as mechanism evidence. Cart n=1 degeneracy, 7 tasks (3+3+1), Magento single site, truncated-first-20 sampling, and PYTHONHASHSEED=0 set-iteration variance (delta 0.0059 at n20) must remain in validity_notes and bound claim ceiling to that sampling regime.

Directly measure full-DOM ranking agreement at n=21-82 if Docker image am1n3e/webarena-verified-shopping:latest becomes available (EXP-INTEL-35462974425): neither parent nor corrected model provides a validated extrapolation. Do not iterate additional reanalyses of the same 4-point margin series without new data; the smallest next step that could answer whether agreement crosses 80% is empirical full-DOM enumeration, not another transform of mean/std.

claim_ceiling: MAX JUSTIFIED: Corrected SNR Phi(mean/std) using across-iteration margin_std is MEASUREMENT_INVALID per frozen rule: C1 fails at n20 (residual 17.8pp >10pp, n15 passes at 6.5pp). Despite 7.7x/2.5x improvement over parent SE-based model (residuals 50.0pp->6.5pp at n15, 44.1pp->17.8pp at n20) and confirming margin_std (~1e-4 to 6e-4) is the correct direction vs SE (~1e-5), the ratio conflates sign and magnitude and overpredicts at larger n where std grows faster (exponent 1.64) than |mean| (0.88). Proportion(margin>0) at 0.4996/0.5654 residuals 0.02/0.59pp shows sign fraction, not mean/std, drives agreement under template invariance (rho=1.0 tautology, single Magento site, truncated-first-20, n=3 per type). No mechanism (C2 margin_deficit true, C2 gated) or full-DOM extrapolation (C3 true predicting 0.575 at n50 PI90 [0.511,0.774] but gated, built on 4-point sign-crossing |margin| R² 0.197) is validated. Null does not beat model at n15 due to ceiling. No inference whether ranking agreement crosses 80% at n=21-82; Docker re-collection remains unvalidated and product lane must not adopt non-recipe density nor invest in full-DOM on basis of this extrapolation. Descriptive ceiling only: canonical eta2 0.919 with agreement 0.565 at n20, monotonic Spearman 1.0 across n, and demonstration that neither SNR decomposition captures the 56% plateau.
